newsitem.title: CROATIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BEAT RUSEDSKI IN CROATIA FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BEAT RUSEDSKI IN CROATIA FINAL.

text.p: Croatia's defending champion Goran Ivanisevic beat Briton Greg Rusedski 7-6 (7-4) 4-6 7-6 (10-8) in a tough final of the Croatian Indoor men's tournament final on Sunday.
The top seed and world number two served a total of 23 and, more crucially, kept his nerve better in the tie-breaks as he secured his 18th career title.
"I had two goals this year, to defend a tournament title and to win the Grand Slam. Now I achieved the first goal," said Ivanisevic, visibly exhausted.
Rusedski, who upset second seed Thomas Enquist in Saturday's semifinals, produced 18 aces but lost his composure right at the end to double fault on match point.,
"Goran was too good today but there'll be another time and I'm sure I'll get my revenge at Wimbledon this year," Rusedski said.
